For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Roll table rows up.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> roll up {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--by, -b {int}`: Number of rows to roll.


## Input/output types:

| input | output |
| ----- | ------ |
| table | table  |
## Examples

Rolls rows up
```nu
> [[a b]; [1 2] [3 4] [5 6]] | roll up
╭───┬───┬───╮
│ # │ a │ b │
├───┼───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 3 │ 4 │
│ 1 │ 5 │ 6 │
│ 2 │ 1 │ 2 │
╰───┴───┴───╯

```
